Who We Are
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity
 The position is within the Digital Services unit—specifically the Operations tribe—which designs, develops, and hosts multi-channel payment and authentication applications for major French and international clients.
This work aligns with key trends in new payment methods and strong authentication for the internet and mobile, while ensuring compliance with new European regulations regarding the security of identity and banking data.
 Day-to-day Responsibilities
 As a Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the testing process and its implementation within a DS project or release.
In this capacity, you will ensure the effective execution of testing across multiple projects within the organization.
 This Includes The Following Tasks
Establishing and managing the testing process.
Organizing, independently managing, and conducting test project reviews, and determining whether objectives have been met.
Contributing to the improvement of the testing process.
Handling project reporting and keeping project management and teams informed.
Coordinating relationships with various stakeholders.
 The Challenges For The Test Engineer Include
Reducing the volume of production defects and the workload associated with corrective maintenance.
Improving user satisfaction.
Increasing confidence in product quality.
 Who Are We Looking For
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
 Final university degree in software testing, software engineering or equivalent education
 At least 3 years of experience in software testing, both manual and automation
 Experience in Selenium, Jira, Confluence
 Able to design the framework, suggest modification in the existing framework
 Experience in fraud detection systems or Payment business major plus
 Autonomy, positive attitude, attention to detail, adaptability and leadership skills
 English business fluent
 Perks & Benefits
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
